CA.rationale: No attention/allocation relation to content is asserted; A absent.

COD.rationale: Content (red set), its organization/origin, and a separate status/origin field are all explicitly present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation linked to content organization/access is asserted.

C.rationale: The report explicitly lists identified contents (color-labeled cell sets) with attributes.

D.rationale: Content sets and a separate origin/status field are both reported for the same referent/time, indicating a distinction between content identity and its organization/status.

O.rationale: The report states how the content is organized/presented via explicit origin/record fields for the referent/time.
